units: <cite ref="Ketubot 19b:1">Keth. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דע׳ הוא אע׳ חתמי</he> since it (the holding of a bill of indebtedness on trust, v. <cite ref="A02041"><he>אֲמָנָה</he></cite>) is a wrong, (a violation of the rule, ‘harbor no wrong in thy tent’, <cite ref="Job 11:14">Job XI, 14</cite>), they would not have lent their signature to a wrong act; a. e.
